Danny asked if all the infrastructure work today made me more capable of helping with Anki cards. Answer: NO — because all 524 tips were about self-improvement, not about being useful to Danny. The flywheel was navel-gazing.

### What was done:
1. Session searched 5 past UWorld/Anki sessions to extract patterns
2. Distilled 12 concrete, actionable tips covering:
   - Anki card formatting (cloze structure, Text field vs Back Extra, CSS AnKing-style)
   - Anki CSS specifics (mobile 15px, .mobile .card specificity, desktop 28px)
   - AnkiConnect quirks (batch addNotes duplicates, individual retry pattern)
   - Anki safety (never open collection.anki2 with sqlite3 while Anki running)
   - UWorld API auth (3 mandatory headers, JWT expiry, sessionStorage extraction)
   - UWorld API body format (PascalCase, STRING TestRecordId, correctAnswer is STRING)
   - UWorld filtering (broad system-level over narrow topic+system, system name mappings)
   - UWorld image question parsing (choice field text vs letter-only)
   - Pipeline scripts (phase1_broad.py, phase2_broad_v2.py, data directory)
   - Study stats (1,822 UWorld + 4,077 AnKing = ~5,899 total cards)

3. Fixed domain normalization: added "anki" → tool_use, "uworld" → tool_use mappings to fn_normalize_domain() trigger
4. Re-domained 13 squashed tips from "general" to "tool_use"
5. Embedded all 12 new tips with sentence-transformers
6. Boosted elo to 2100, frequency to 5, confidence to 0.95 so they compete in hybrid_search
7. Verified retrieval: all anki/uworld queries return our tips as top results (sim 0.44-0.80)
